super_nodes.label: Mixed foundational methods and software
super_nodes.gloss: A broad mix of simulation codes (VASP, LAMMPS, AFLOW), DFT+U variants, and ML potential/architecture methods (GAP, ACE, DeepMD, ConvLSTM) without one unifying theme.

super_nodes.label: Materials databases, screening, future directions
super_nodes.gloss: Centers on large materials databases (Materials Project, JARVIS) and their use for high-throughput screening, mixed with many problem and future-topic statements.

super_nodes.label: Classical and early ML interatomic potentials
super_nodes.gloss: Groups foundational interatomic-potential methods, from empirical potentials (Tersoff, Brenner, REBO) to early ML potentials (Behler-Parrinello, GAP, kernel methods).

super_nodes.label: Graph neural network architectures
super_nodes.gloss: Covers message-passing and graph-convolutional neural network architectures (MPNN, SchNet-family, CGCNN) and their layers, with claims about molecular-property benchmark accuracy.

super_nodes.label: Automated ML pipelines and benchmarking
super_nodes.gloss: Focuses on automated machine-learning pipelines like Automatminer and the Matbench benchmark suite for comparing materials-property prediction models.

super_nodes.label: Atomic structure descriptors and featurization
super_nodes.gloss: Groups structural descriptor and featurization schemes used as ML input representations, including SOAP, Coulomb-matrix variants, and n-body descriptor sets.

super_nodes.label: Battery materials and electrolyte screening
super_nodes.gloss: Covers high-throughput screening and ML/DFT prediction of battery-relevant materials, especially solid electrolytes (LGPS, LLZO, NASICON) and ionic conductivity.

super_nodes.label: Benchmark molecular and materials datasets
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly a list of standard benchmark datasets (QM9, MD17 molecules, OC20 variants) used to train and evaluate ML potentials, plus a few related methods.

super_nodes.label: DFT functionals and GAP potential validation
super_nodes.gloss: Claims and methods about DFT exchange-correlation functional choices and validating the GAP interatomic potential, largely for silicon, against DFT reference data.

super_nodes.label: High-throughput DFT workflow automation
super_nodes.gloss: Covers automated DFT calculation workflows (FireWorks, AFLOW) and technical correction and convergence schemes such as DFT+U parameters and k-point settings.

super_nodes.label: Fracture prediction and interstitial-site search
super_nodes.gloss: Combines two distinct threads: a ConvLSTM model for predicting crystal fracture patterns, and an AFLOW algorithm for finding interstitial sites, with no shared theme.

super_nodes.label: GAP potential for amorphous/liquid carbon
super_nodes.gloss: Focuses on validating the GAP interatomic potential against DFT for amorphous and liquid carbon structures, including surface energies and melt-quench simulation tooling.

super_nodes.label: MEGNet and related architecture citations
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly cited works and components around the MEGNet graph-network architecture and related software, with a few unrelated citations mixed in.

super_nodes.label: Large materials databases
super_nodes.gloss: Describes major computational materials databases (Materials Project, AFLOW, OQMD), their scale and APIs, and their use for screening and benchmark construction.

super_nodes.label: Simulation codes and composition featurizers
super_nodes.gloss: A mix of DFT and MD simulation software (VASP, LAMMPS, CASTEP) and composition-based featurization or AutoML tools (Magpie, TPOT).

super_nodes.label: Miscellaneous cited authors and tools
super_nodes.gloss: A loose grouping of cited author references, the pymatgen software, and the Grimme-D2 dispersion correction, without one clear shared topic.

super_nodes.label: Empirical and early neural-network potentials
super_nodes.gloss: Groups classical empirical potentials (Tersoff, Brenner, REBO, ReaxFF) alongside early neural-network potential methods such as Behler-Parrinello and Deep Potential.

super_nodes.label: Optimization techniques for training
super_nodes.gloss: Covers optimizer choices (Adam, evolutionary algorithms) and activation functions (softplus) used for neural-network training and atomic geometry optimization.

super_nodes.label: Graph neural network architectures
super_nodes.gloss: Covers message-passing and graph-convolutional neural network architectures (MPNN, CGCNN-family) and their components, with claims about molecular benchmark accuracy.

super_nodes.label: Iterative training and active-learning workflows
super_nodes.gloss: Groups techniques for iterative model training, active learning, and training-set cleaning, centered on the Set2Set readout component.

super_nodes.label: DFT+U variants and electronic-structure solvers
super_nodes.gloss: A mix of DFT+U correction schemes, electronic-structure minimization methods, and a few unrelated ML potential citations (GAP, DeepMD, GDML).

super_nodes.label: Kernel-based similarity methods
super_nodes.gloss: Groups kernel-construction techniques (power spectrum, kernel normalization) used in kernel-based ML potentials such as GAP.

super_nodes.label: Matrix descriptors and sparsification
super_nodes.gloss: Covers matrix-based structural descriptors (Coulomb matrix variants) and matrix sparsification or decomposition techniques (CUR) used to build them.

super_nodes.label: Battery materials and electrolyte screening
super_nodes.gloss: Covers high-throughput screening and prediction of battery-relevant materials, especially solid electrolytes (LGPS, LLZO, NASICON) and ionic conductivity.

super_nodes.label: Force locality in diamond and graphite
super_nodes.gloss: A small cluster about force locality and interlayer-spacing differences between diamond and graphite, using SOAP/SNAP-style descriptors and workflow components.

super_nodes.label: Uncertainty quantification and tensorial expansions
super_nodes.gloss: Covers uncertainty-quantification methods and tensorial or spherical-harmonic expansion techniques (ACE, MTP, GAP) for machine-learned interatomic potentials.

super_nodes.label: DFT exchange-correlation functionals
super_nodes.gloss: Lists DFT methods and functional choices (PBE, HSE06, TBmBJ, hybrid functionals) used for electronic-structure and density-of-states calculations.

super_nodes.label: Quantum ESPRESSO integration and k-points
super_nodes.gloss: A small cluster about integrating the Quantum ESPRESSO code and standardizing its k-point density parameters across databases.

super_nodes.label: JARVIS integrated materials-design toolkit
super_nodes.gloss: Covers the JARVIS software ecosystem, including its DFT, force-field, machine-learning, and tight-binding sub-tools, for integrated materials design.

super_nodes.label: DFT accuracy, cost, reproducibility tradeoffs
super_nodes.gloss: Problem statements and methods about balancing DFT accuracy against computational cost and ensuring reproducibility in high-throughput calculations.

super_nodes.label: DFT charge-mixing and force corrections
super_nodes.gloss: A small cluster of technical DFT convergence-acceleration and force-correction methods, including Pulay mixing and Harris-Foulkes corrections.

super_nodes.label: Loss scheduling and gradient-based training
super_nodes.gloss: Covers training techniques such as loss-term weighting schedules, gradient-based optimizers, and transfer learning used when fitting ML potentials.

super_nodes.label: MD17-family molecular benchmark datasets
super_nodes.gloss: A list of standard small-molecule and liquid-carbon molecular-dynamics benchmark datasets, namely MD17 and its revised variants.

super_nodes.label: Benchmark evaluation metrics and MLIP methods
super_nodes.gloss: A cluster of accuracy metrics (MAE, RMSE, error ratio) paired with several machine-learned interatomic potential method names and structure or energy benchmark datasets.

super_nodes.label: Automated ML pipelines and benchmarking
super_nodes.gloss: Covers the Automatminer automated machine-learning pipeline and the Matbench benchmark suite for materials-property prediction models.

super_nodes.label: Classical ML models and evaluation
super_nodes.gloss: Groups classical machine-learning models (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting) with standard evaluation techniques such as cross-validation and feature-importance analysis.

super_nodes.label: DFT and GAP accuracy validation claims
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly claims quantifying how closely DFT functionals and the GAP potential, especially for silicon, reproduce experimental or reference values.

super_nodes.label: Crystal graph property-prediction tasks
super_nodes.gloss: Task and problem statements around predicting materials properties (elastic moduli, metallicity, energies) using crystal graph networks like CGCNN and Matbench-style benchmarks.

super_nodes.label: AFLOW workflow automation tooling
super_nodes.gloss: Components and techniques of the AFLOW high-throughput workflow engine, including automated job orchestration and failure recovery.

super_nodes.label: Molecular dynamics simulation methods
super_nodes.gloss: Covers ab initio and classical molecular-dynamics methods (Car-Parrinello, LAMMPS, ASE) and related components, plus problems around simulation cost and accuracy.

super_nodes.label: ConvLSTM-based fracture prediction
super_nodes.gloss: Covers a ConvLSTM model predicting crystal fracture patterns and toughness, including its generalization to bicrystal and gradient-orientation structures.

super_nodes.label: Force, energy, and virial prediction
super_nodes.gloss: Problems and tasks about jointly predicting energies, forces, and virial or stress tensors, and benchmarking classical force fields such as JARVIS-FF.

super_nodes.label: ACE with magnetic and charge extensions
super_nodes.gloss: Focuses on extending the Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) potential framework to include magnetic moments and charge-transfer degrees of freedom.

super_nodes.label: Property-prediction generalization and future work
super_nodes.gloss: A problem- and future-topic-heavy cluster about extending property-prediction models (activation energies, formation energies) to new chemistries and benchmarks.

super_nodes.label: Benchmarking neural potential architectures
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly claims comparing the accuracy of SchNet, MPNN, MEGNet, and DeePMD against each other and DFT or experiment across common benchmarks.

super_nodes.label: Band structure and phonon calculation tasks
super_nodes.gloss: Task statements around computing electronic band structure, band gaps, and phonon dispersion, plus the underlying calculation methods.

super_nodes.label: Numerical convergence criteria
super_nodes.gloss: Technical convergence thresholds and checks (k-point, SCF, bond-length) used to validate DFT calculations and clean ML training data.

super_nodes.label: AFLOW data infrastructure and REST API
super_nodes.gloss: Covers AFLOW's web infrastructure and REST API for sharing computational data, and the manual, fragmented data-management problems it addresses.

super_nodes.label: Configuration-space sampling for training data
super_nodes.gloss: Covers sampling strategies (ensemble sampling, snapshot extraction, k-point sampling) used to build representative training sets for ML potentials.

super_nodes.label: LPSO alloy stability and sp3 concentration
super_nodes.gloss: Combines two small, distinct threads: predicting stability of Mg-based LPSO alloy precipitates, and monitoring sp2/sp3 carbon bonding concentration.

super_nodes.label: Miscellaneous small tools
super_nodes.gloss: A very small, disparate group: a Brillouin-zone path standard, a heterostructure tool, and the projector-augmented-wave method, with no shared theme.

super_nodes.label: Interstitial site detection (AFLOW)
super_nodes.gloss: A focused cluster about AFLOW's topological algorithm for finding and classifying interstitial cage sites in crystal structures.

super_nodes.label: GAP potential for amorphous carbon
super_nodes.gloss: Claims and tasks around validating the GAP potential for simulating amorphous and liquid carbon structures against DFT reference data.

super_nodes.label: Normalization and scaling in ML potentials
super_nodes.gloss: Groups normalization and scaling techniques (batch normalization, composition-weighted averaging, linear scaling) used in training and lattice-parameter prediction.

super_nodes.label: STM image simulation and analysis
super_nodes.gloss: A small cluster about simulating and classifying scanning tunneling microscopy images using distance-binning and Tersoff-Hamann methods.

super_nodes.label: Atomic structure descriptors (SOAP/CFID)
super_nodes.gloss: Lists variants of SOAP and CFID-style structural descriptors, including n-body decompositions, and the rotational-invariance problem they address.

super_nodes.label: Force locality and state-dependence testing
super_nodes.gloss: Covers tests for how local and state-dependent an ML potential's force predictions are, including displacement and locality tests.

super_nodes.label: Workflow error-handling and featurizers
super_nodes.gloss: Combines automated calculation-failure recovery tooling (self-healing, error detection) with a set of composition-based featurizers (ElementProperty, EwaldEnergy).

super_nodes.label: Convex-hull thermodynamic stability analysis
super_nodes.gloss: Covers methods for assessing thermodynamic and phase stability of materials via convex-hull construction and stability ranking.

super_nodes.label: Surface structure and surface-energy modeling
super_nodes.gloss: Covers building and simulating surface slabs and computing surface energies, especially for amorphous carbon (ta-C) surfaces.

super_nodes.label: Point defect analysis tooling
super_nodes.gloss: A very small cluster of tooling for point-defect analysis, including topological spillage analysis and dimer/trimer training-data inclusion.

super_nodes.label: Melt-quench simulation protocol
super_nodes.gloss: Covers the melt-quench molecular-dynamics simulation protocol (temperature ramping, thermostats) used partly for thermoelectric property prediction.
